title: Shedding light on development: Leveraging the new nightlights data to measure economic progress
Extreme Weather Events and Climate Change: Economic Impacts and Adaptation Policies
abstract: This article reviews the literature on the economic impacts of disasters caused by extreme weather and climate events to draw lessons on how societies can better manage these risks. While evidence that richer, better governed societies suffer less and recover faster from climate extremes suggests adaptation, knowledge gaps remain, and little is known about the efficiency of specific adaptation actions. I review various "no or low" regrets adaptation options which are recommended when uncertainties over climate change impacts are high. I discuss how governments can play an important role in adaptation by directly providing public goods to manage disaster risks or by facilitating private agents' adaptation responses, but also highlight the political economy of policy and coordination failures.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了极端天气和气候事件所导致灾害的经济影响文献，以总结社会如何更好地管理这些风险的经验教训。尽管有证据表明，治理更好、更富裕的社会在气候极端事件中损失更小、恢复更快，这暗示了适应的重要性，但仍存在知识空白，人们对具体适应行动的效率知之甚少。我讨论了各种“无悔或低悔”（no or low regrets）的适应选项，这些选项在气候变化影响的不确定性较高时受到推荐。我还讨论了政府如何通过直接提供公共品以管理灾害风险，或通过促进私人主体的适应性反应，在适应中发挥重要作用，同时也强调了政策的政治经济学问题以及政策协调失灵的问题。

title: Fisherfolk contingent valuation of marine restoration in Gujarat, India
Understanding Public Acceptability of Climate Policies in Europe
abstract: Urgent and decisive government action to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions is more likely when the proposed measures are popular among the public. This paper compares the drivers of European public support for three alternative policies to combat climate change: carbon taxation, renewable energy subsidies, and minimum energy efficiency standards that apply to household appliances. We combine survey data with regional socio-economic and environmental indicators to provide a comprehensive, comparative analysis of policy acceptance that accounts for the geographic context in which these policies would be implemented. By comparing the drivers among three climate policies, we identify a rural-urban gap in predicting public perception of carbon taxation, which does not exist in the other policies. We also found a positive relationship between regional exposure to fine particular matter (PM2.5) and public support for climate policy, providing novel insights into the influence of environmental factors on public perceptions. This research highlights the importance of environmental and socio-economic context in predicting climate policy acceptance and offers valuable implications for policymakers seeking to garner public support for effective climate change mitigation strategies.
abstract_zh: 政府对温室气体排放采取紧急而果断的减排行动，在所提议的措施获得公众支持时更有可能实现。本文比较了欧洲公众支持三种不同应对气候变化政策的驱动因素：碳税、可再生能源补贴以及适用于家用电器的最低能效标准。我们将调查数据与区域社会经济和环境指标相结合，对政策接受度进行了全面的比较分析，并考虑了这些政策实施所处的地理背景。通过比较三种气候政策的驱动因素，我们发现城乡差距在预测公众对碳税的看法时存在，而在其他政策中并不存在。我们还发现，区域细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露水平与公众对气候政策的支持之间存在正相关关系，这为环境因素如何影响公众认知提供了新的见解。本研究强调了环境和社会经济背景在预测气候政策接受度方面的重要性，并为希望争取公众支持、推行有效气候变化减缓战略的政策制定者提供了有价值的启示。

title: Well-Being Effects of Extreme Weather Events in the United States
abstract: We match forty-two billion-dollar disasters with individual survey data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System between 2005 and 2010 to estimate the effect of extreme weather events on the subjective well-being of U.S. residents Our results indicate that natural disasters have a negative and robust impact on subjective well-being, and that this impact decays over time, disappearing 6 to 8 months after the event. Finding severe storms as the main culprit in the reduction of individual life satisfaction in our sample, we show that their impact diminishes further than 50 km from the affected counties. We then investigate the attenuating impact of health care access and natural-peril insurance and find a partial compensating role for both protective measures.
abstract_zh: 我们将2005至2010年间的42起十亿美元级灾害与行为风险因素监测系统（Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System）的个人调查数据相匹配，以估计极端天气事件对美国居民主观幸福感的影响。结果表明，自然灾害对主观幸福感有负面且稳健的影响，并且这种影响随时间衰减，在事件发生6至8个月后消失。在我们的样本中，我们发现严重风暴是导致个人生活满意度下降的主要原因，并且其影响在超过受灾县50公里之外便进一步减弱。随后，我们考察了医疗服务可及性和自然灾害保险对上述影响的缓解作用，发现这两种保护措施均起到了部分补偿作用。

title: Temperature and self-reported mental health in the United States
abstract: This study estimates the association between temperature and self-reported mental health. We match individual-level mental health data for over three million Americans between 1993 and 2010 to historical daily weather information. We exploit the random fluctuations in temperature over time within counties to identify its effect on a 30-day measure of self-reported mental health. Compared to the temperature range of 60-70°F, cooler days in the past month reduce the probability of reporting days of bad mental health while hotter days increase this probability. We also find a salience effect: cooler days have an immediate effect, whereas hotter days tend to matter most after about 10 days. Using our estimates, we calculate the willingness to pay to avoid an additional hot day in terms of its impact on self-reported mental health.
abstract_zh: 本研究估计了气温与自我报告的心理健康之间的关联。我们将1993至2010年间超过三百万美国人的个人层面心理健康数据，与历史每日天气信息进行匹配。我们利用各县内气温随时间的随机波动来识别其对30天自我报告心理健康指标的影响。与60至70华氏度（°F）的气温区间相比，过去一个月中较凉爽的天数降低了报告心理健康状况不佳天数的概率，而较炎热的天数则提高了这一概率。我们还发现了显著性效应：凉爽天气会产生即时影响，而炎热天气则大约在10天后才最为显著。利用我们的估计结果，我们计算了为避免一个额外炎热日对自我报告心理健康的影响，人们愿意支付的金额，即意愿支付（willingness to pay）。

title: Towards a Characterization of Working Forest Conservation Easements in Georgia, USA
abstract: We examine the attributes of working forest conservation easements in Georgia. Easement contracts and baseline reports are inspected to investigate easement themes, land use types, recreation opportunities, hydrological features, and forest management activity. Easement themes are heavily weighted towards themes of protecting natural habitat and preserving the conservation values of properties. Predominant land use types include wildlife food plots, bottomland hardwoods, and planted pine stands. Common hydrological features found were small creeks/streams and ponds. Lastly, forest management was characterized as having small amounts of restrictions present, with forest management being largely similar to other unencumbered property in the southeastern USA. This information can be used as a reference for landowners interested in establishing a working forest conservation easement (WFCE) on their property as well as a tool for comparison for researchers investigating easement characteristics in other regions.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了佐治亚州经营性林地保护地役权（working forest conservation easements）的特征。通过检查地役权合同和基线报告，我们分析了地役权的主题、土地利用类型、游憩机会、水文特征以及森林经营活动。地役权主题主要集中于保护自然栖息地和维护物业的保护价值。主要的土地利用类型包括野生动物饲料地、河漫滩阔叶林以及人工种植的松林。常见的水文特征为小溪流和池塘。最后，森林经营的限制较少，总体上与美国东南部其他未设限的产权土地相似。这些信息可作为有意在其土地上设立经营性林地保护地役权（WFCE）的土地所有者的参考，也可作为研究其他地区地役权特征的研究者的比较工具。

Flood Insurance and Risk Reduction: Market Penetration, Coverage, and Mitigation in Coastal North Carolina
abstract: This article provides an overview of flood risk management in the United States, focusing on the National Flood Insurance Program and the Community Ratings System (CRS), which is designed to promote flood hazard mitigation. We review the empirical literature that examines market penetration and demand for flood insurance, as well as factors that influence community participation in CRS. Combining data from separate (but similar) surveys conducted in Dare County, North Carolina in 1998 and 2008, we examine trends in flood insurance holdings and explore the extensive (binary participation) and intensive (coverage level) margins using regression analysis. We explore trends in CRS mitigation activities in Dare County and discuss potential difficulties in analyzing these data. Finally, we highlight avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文概述了美国的洪水风险管理，重点关注国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）以及旨在促进洪水灾害减缓的社区评级系统（CRS）。我们回顾了考察洪水保险市场渗透率与需求的实证文献，以及影响社区参与CRS的因素。结合1998年和2008年在北卡罗来纳州达尔县（Dare County）开展的两项独立但相似的调查数据，我们考察了洪水保险持有情况的变化趋势，并利用回归分析探讨了广延边际（是否参保的二元参与）和集约边际（保障水平）。我们还探讨了达尔县CRS减缓活动的趋势，并讨论了分析这些数据可能遇到的困难。最后，我们指出了未来研究的方向。

Floods and Armed Conflict
abstract: We estimate the impact of large, catastrophic floods on internal armed conflict using global data on large floods between 1985 and 2009. The results suggest that while large floods did not ignite new conflict, they fueled existing armed conflicts. Floods and armed conflict are endogenously determined, and we show that empirically addressing this endogeneity is important. The estimated effects of floods on conflict prevalence are substantially larger in specifications that control for the endogeneity of floods, suggesting that treating natural disasters as exogenous phenomena may underestimate their impacts on sociopolitical outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1985至2009年间全球大洪水的数据，估计了特大灾难性洪水对国内武装冲突的影响。结果表明，虽然大洪水并未引发新的冲突，但却助长了已有的武装冲突。洪水与武装冲突之间存在内生性关系，我们表明，在实证上处理这种内生性十分重要。在控制了洪水内生性的设定中，洪水对冲突发生率的估计效应明显更大，这表明，若将自然灾害视为外生现象，可能低估其对社会政治结果的影响。

Environment, Well-Being and Experienced Preference
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Recent years have seen a sharp increase in the use of subjective well-being data in environmental economics. This article discusses the conceptual underpinnings of using such data as a tool for preference elicitation and non-market valuation. Given the connection of those data to the notion of experienced utility, we refer to this approach as the experienced preference method and discuss recent methodological advances and applications of the approach to subject areas not previously reviewed. In addition, we discuss insights concerning environmental behavior that can be gained with the help of subjective well-being data.
abstract_zh: 近年来，主观幸福感数据在环境经济学中的应用急剧增加。本文讨论了使用此类数据作为偏好引出和非市场价值评估工具的概念基础。鉴于这些数据与体验效用（experienced utility）概念之间的联系，我们将这一方法称为体验偏好法（experienced preference method），并讨论了该方法近期的方法论进展，以及其在以往综述中未涉及的研究领域中的应用。此外，我们还讨论了借助主观幸福感数据所能获得的关于环境行为的见解。

title: The Macroeconomic Impacts of Natural Disasters: The case of Floods
Trajectories of adaptation: A retrospectus for future dynamics
Does development reduce fatalities from natural disasters? New evidence for floods
abstract: We analyze the impact of development on flood fatalities using a new data set of 2,171 large floods in 92 countries between 1985 and 2008. Our results challenge the conventional wisdom that development results in fewer fatalities during natural disasters. Results indicating that higher income and better governance reduce fatalities during flood events do not hold up when unobserved country heterogeneity and within-country correlation of standard errors are taken into account. We find that income does have a significant, indirect effect on flood fatalities by affecting flood frequency and flood magnitude, but this effect is nonmonotonic, with net reductions in fatalities occurring only in lower income countries. We find little evidence that improved governance affects flood fatalities either directly or indirectly.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个涵盖1985年至2008年间92个国家2,171起大洪水的新数据集，分析了发展对洪涝死亡人数的影响。我们的结果挑战了“发展可减少自然灾害死亡人数”这一传统观点。收入较高和治理较好能减少洪水事件死亡人数的结论，在考虑了未观测到的国家异质性以及国家内部标准误的相关性之后便不再成立。我们发现，收入通过影响洪水频率和洪水规模，对洪涝死亡人数确有显著的间接影响，但这种影响是非单调的：只有在低收入国家，死亡人数才会出现净减少。我们几乎没有发现证据表明治理改善会直接或间接影响洪涝死亡人数。

title: Forgetting the Flood? An Analysis of the Flood Risk Discount over Time
abstract: We examine whether property price differentials reflecting flood risk increase following a large flood event, and whether this change is temporary or permanent. We use single-family residential property sales in Dougherty County, Georgia, between 1985 and 2004 in a difference-in-differences spatial hedonic model framework. After the 1994 “flood of the century,” prices of properties in the 100-year floodplain fell significantly. This effect was, however, short-lived. In spatial hedonic models that explicitly incorporate both linear and nonlinear temporal flood-zone effects, we show that the flood risk discount disappeared between four and nine years after the flood, depending upon the specification. (JEL Q51, Q54)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了反映洪水风险的房产价格差异在一次大洪水事件后是否会扩大，以及这种变化是暂时的还是永久的。我们在双重差分空间特征价格模型框架下，使用了1985至2004年间佐治亚州多尔蒂县（Dougherty County）的单户住宅产权交易数据。在1994年的“世纪洪水”之后，位于百年一遇洪泛区内的房产价格显著下跌。然而，这一效应是短暂的。在同时纳入线性和非线性时间性洪水区效应的空间特征价格模型中，我们发现，根据模型设定的不同，洪水风险折价在洪水发生后四至九年间消失。（JEL Q51, Q54）

title: Income and Preferences for the Environment: Evidence from Subjective Well-Being Data
abstract: Do people care more about the environment as their income increases? In this paper we use a measure of subjective well-being to directly analyze whether the impact of a number of environmental amenities on self-reported life satisfaction varies with income. We find little empirical support for the marginal effects of environmental amenities being larger for the richest.
abstract_zh: 人们是否会随着收入增长而更加关心环境？在本文中，我们利用主观幸福感指标，直接分析了多种环境舒适物对自我报告的生活满意度的影响是否随收入而变化。我们发现，几乎没有实证证据支持环境舒适物的边际效应对最富裕人群而言更大。

title: Life Satisfaction and Air Quality in Europe
abstract: Concerns for environmental quality and its impact on people's welfare are fundamental arguments for the adoption of environmental legislation in most countries. In this paper, we analyse the relationship between air quality and subjective well-being in Europe. We use a unique dataset that merges three waves of the European Social Survey with a new dataset on environmental quality including SO2 concentrations and climate in Europe at the regional level. We find a robust negative impact of SO2 concentrations on self-reported life satisfaction.
abstract_zh: 对环境质量及其对人民福利影响的关切，是大多数国家通过环境立法的根本理由。在本文中，我们分析了欧洲空气质量与主观幸福感之间的关系。我们使用了一个独特的数据集，该数据集将欧洲社会调查（European Social Survey）的三轮数据与一个新的区域层面环境质量数据集相合并，后者包括欧洲的二氧化硫（SO2）浓度和气候信息。我们发现，SO2浓度对自我报告的生活满意度具有稳健的负面影响。

title: Controlling Diseases and Nuisances: Time-Based Rights and Agricultural Production
Forest cover, socioeconomics, and reported flood frequency in developing countries
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the determinants of the number of large floods reported since 1990. Using the same sample of countries as Bradshaw et al. (2007), and, like them, omitting socioeconomic characteristics from the analysis, we found that a reduction in natural forest cover is associated with an increase in the reported count of large floods. This result does not hold in any of three new analyses we perform. First, we expand the sample to include all the developing countries and all countries for which data were available but were omitted in their study. Second, and more importantly, since forest management is just one possible channel through which humans can influence reported flood frequency, we account for other important human–flood interactions. People are typically responsible for deforestation, but they are also responsible for other land use changes (e.g., urbanization), for floodplain and flood emergency management, and for reporting the floods. Thus, in our analysis we account for population, urban population growth, income, and corruption. Third, we exploit the panel nature of the data to control for unobserved country and time heterogeneity. We conclude that not only is the link between forest cover and reported flood frequency at the country level not robust, it also seems to be driven by sample selection and omitted variable bias. The human impact on the reported frequency of large floods at the country level is not through deforestation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了1990年以来所报告的大洪水次数的决定因素。使用与Bradshaw等人（2007）相同的国家样本，并像他们一样在分析中省略社会经济特征，我们发现天然林覆盖面积的减少与所报告的大洪水次数增加相关。然而，这一结果在我们进行的三项新分析中均不成立。第一，我们将样本扩展至所有发展中国家以及所有有数据但在其研究中被遗漏的国家。第二，也是更为重要的一点，由于森林管理只是人类影响洪水报告频率的可能途径之一，我们还考虑了其他重要的人类与洪水之间的相互作用。人类通常对森林砍伐负责，但也对其他土地利用变化（例如城市化）、洪泛区和洪水应急管理以及洪水报告负责。因此，在分析中，我们控制了人口、城市人口增长、收入和腐败程度。第三，我们利用数据的面板特性来控制不可观测的国家和时间异质性。我们的结论是，在国家层面，森林覆盖与所报告洪水频率之间的联系不仅不稳健，而且似乎是由样本选择偏误和遗漏变量偏误驱动的。人类对大洪水报告频率的影响，并非通过森林砍伐在国家层面实现的。

abstract: Despite the potential energy savings and economic benefits associated with compact fluorescent light bulbs (CFL’s), their adoption by the residential sector has been limited to date. In this paper, we present a theoretical model that focuses on the agents’ ability to perceive the correct cost of lighting and on the role of environmental attitudes as key determinants of the adoption decision. We use original data from Ireland to test our theoretical predictions. Our results emphasize the importance of education, information and environmental awareness in the adoption decision.
abstract_zh: 尽管紧凑型荧光灯（CFL）具有潜在的节能和经济效益，但迄今为止其在居民部门的采用一直有限。在本文中，我们提出了一个理论模型，重点关注行为主体感知照明正确成本的能力，以及环境态度作为采用决策关键决定因素的作用。我们使用来自爱尔兰的原始数据检验了我们的理论预测。结果强调了教育、信息和环境意识在采用决策中的重要性。

Genuine savings: Leading Indicator of Sustainable Development?
abstract: The World Bank recently began publishing estimates of countries’ “genuine savings”: a comprehensive measure of net investment across all forms of capital (natural and human as well as produced). This article presents the first empirical investigation of the consistency of the Bank’s estimates with the hypothesis that net investment should equal the difference between a country’s average future consumption and its current consumption. Results show that the Bank’s estimates are consistent only with weak versions of this hypothesis and then only for developing countries. Moreover, a simple autoregressive‐integrated‐moving‐average (ARIMA) model outperforms any net investment measure, comprehensive or conventional, as a predictor of the difference between current and future consumption. In sum, the Bank’s net investment estimates tend to move in the same direction as the difference between current and average future consumption in developing countries, but they have little value for predicting the magnitude of this difference.
abstract_zh: 世界银行近期开始公布各国的“真实储蓄”（genuine savings）估计数：这是一项涵盖所有形式资本（自然资本、人力资本以及生产性资本）的净投资综合衡量指标。本文首次对世界银行的估计是否与以下假设相一致进行了实证检验：净投资应等于一国未来平均消费与当前消费之差。结果表明，世界银行的估计仅与该假设的弱版本相一致，而且仅适用于发展中国家。此外，一个简单的自回归积分移动平均（ARIMA）模型，作为当前消费与未来消费之差的预测指标，其表现优于任何净投资指标（无论是综合性的还是传统的）。总之，在发展中国家，世界银行的净投资估计往往与当前消费和未来平均消费之差的变动方向一致，但在预测这一差距的大小方面价值有限。

title: Deforestation, Property Rights and International Trade
abstract: Deforestation primarily affects developing countries. Most developing countries share two characteristics: (1) trade liberalization reforms in the last two decades, and (2) weak property rights and limited rule of law. This paper investigates this second-best world; first, in a stylized model in which trade distortions are eliminated in an economy whose natural resources are subject to open access; second, empirically in an estimation exercise that disentangles the direct effect of trade on deforestation rates and an indirect effect through its interaction with ownership security. In accordance with the theory, the results show that only the indirect effect is significant. (JEL F18, O13, Q21)
abstract_zh: 森林砍伐主要影响发展中国家。大多数发展中国家具有两个共同特征：（1）过去二十年中的贸易自由化改革；（2）产权保护薄弱和法治水平有限。本文考察了这种次优世界：首先，在一个自然资源实行开放准入的经济体中，我们构建了一个程式化模型，在其中消除了贸易扭曲；其次，我们进行了实证估计，将贸易对森林砍伐率的直接效应，与其通过与产权安全交互作用产生的间接效应区分开来。与理论一致，结果表明只有间接效应是显著的。（JEL F18, O13, Q21）
